summary: 确认频率可调：inbox brief 增加 ask / digest / quiet 三种确认模式，nudge 增加 confirm 与 prompt_cooldown_hours 配置并在 stop 前先问 gate；文档补充 hook 路径的硬限制与模型自判路径的边界。; 候选收件箱新增条件、目的、不适用与关系备注（缺失仅警告），采纳写入的规则行与 OPINION.md 框架随项目文件语言；en 项目的锁带 language，旧运行时读不了。; 新增声明式客户端驱动注册表（agent_pack_clients）：claude / codex / cursor 与只读的 claude-desktop 由数据声明，客户端名单与 --client 选项改为从注册表派生（既有输出不变）；新增只读命令 agenthelm clients 列出各驱动的检测结果、分发驱动类型与能力标志；预留 ~/.config/agenthelm/clients.d/*.json 用户声明文件，本版只校验，不执行其中任何内容，也不据此安装。; agent-pack 的“旧运行时”回归测试只取早于被测提交的正式发布 tag：候选 tag（含指向被测提交的 -rc.N）不再被当作旧运行时，避免打 rc tag 后 Release 工作流的测试步骤失败。; agenthelm check 对有 opinion.lock.json 的项目运行一次只读的 opinion-manager migrate 预览（5 秒超时、零写入）：有可迁移到标签按需加载的内容时给出一条建议（目标 Profile、更新摘要、未完成的收件箱记录数与可直接复制的预览命令），手工改动或 catalog 冲突时给一条简短说明，其余情况一律静默。建议项不改退出码、不计入 up_to_date；会话开始的 hook 与 nudge 不调用 migrate；check --output json 在有提示时多一个 opinion_migrate 数组，既有字段不变。不迁移则保持原样，不影响现有行为。; 新增只读命令 agenthelm inventory：列出各客户端能看到的 Skill 与 MCP（含 ~/.agents/skills、项目级与 Claude 本地级存储）、重复、description 字节数与可识别来源，输出带 schema_version 的稳定 JSON。; inventory 与 doctor 以独立目标 claude-desktop 只读 Claude Desktop 的 claude_desktop_config.json（须点名或用 --client all，不在默认客户端内）；doctor --client claude 对同名条目给建议级 shadowed-by 提示。; 文档更新：README、INSTALL、MIGRATION 与各插件 Skill 补充技能与 MCP 管理、作用域声明、client 驱动、language=en 启动器更新办法及 6.14.0 迁移说明；write-commands 盘点补全。; agent-pack 新增作用域声明：Project Profile 的 capabilities.default_scope / mcp_scope / skill_scope 与 sync、reconcile 的 --scope。声明为 project 的条目不再写入用户级（本版跳过并警告，项目级写入随后续版本提供），预览按作用域分组并给出收窄影响；不写新键时行为与输出不变。; agent-pack 支持把声明为 project 的 MCP 写到 Claude 项目级存储：默认 local（~/.claude.json 里该项目路径下，写前备份、保持权限、失败回滚），或用 --project-store file 写项目根 .mcp.json（含机器路径的条目被拒绝）。目标不可写或结构无法识别时跳过并警告，不回退写用户级。; agent-pack 支持把声明为 project 的 Skill 写到项目的 .claude/skills（相对符号链接，同步盘内改为复制，同名冲突需 --replace-skills），并在作用域改变时预览「写入新位置」与「从旧位置退役」两步：Skill 的旧位置同一事务归档，MCP 的旧位置只给手工移除命令。同名多存储且官方文档明确优先级时给出建议级屏蔽提示，不影响 ok 与退出码。; 新增 agenthelm relocate：把一个 Skill 复制或迁移到另一个客户端/作用域，默认预览，带计划指纹确认；不覆盖已有目录，读回校验，失败回滚，源只归档不删除；放宽作用域需 --allow-widen。; 新增 agenthelm dedupe：处置 inventory 报告的重复分组。Skill 副本可保留一份并归档其余（可恢复，不删除）；MCP 副本只给官方手工命令，不编辑配置；全部保留与忽略只写机器级决定文件；另提供只读的 Claude Desktop 配置可粘贴片段。; agenthelm relocate 支持 MCP：在 Claude 的 user / local / 项目 .mcp.json 之间复制或迁移条目；预览=应用，不覆盖同名目标，内联密钥值与本机路径不能进入 .mcp.json，只收窄不放宽（放宽需 --allow-widen）。已受管的源条目由 agent-pack 原子改写 ~/.claude.json 并先逐字节备份、可回滚；未受管条目只复制并给手工命令。; agenthelm dedupe --keep --retire-others 对 MCP 副本：已受管的条目由 agent-pack 退役（原 JSON 片段存入 0600 恢复目录、先逐字节备份 ~/.claude.json、原子改写、失败按字节回滚）；未受管的条目仍只给官方手工命令；证据不明的成员仍只读，跨客户端同指纹仍只是建议保留。
summary_en: Confirmation frequency is tunable: inbox brief gains the ask / digest / quiet confirmation modes, nudge gains the confirm and prompt_cooldown_hours settings and asks the gate before stop, and the docs state the hard limits of the hook path and the boundary of the model-judged path.; The candidate inbox gains trigger, purpose, exclusion and relation fields (missing ones only warn); the rule line and OPINION.md frame written on adopt follow the project file language. The lock of an en project carries language, which older runtimes cannot read.; Adds a declarative client-driver registry (agent_pack_clients): claude / codex / cursor and the read-only claude-desktop are declared as data, and the client lists and --client choices derive from it (existing output unchanged). New read-only command agenthelm clients lists each driver's detection result, distribution driver type and capability flags. Reserves user declarations in ~/.config/agenthelm/clients.d/*.json: this version only validates them, never executes anything in them and never installs from them.; The agent-pack older-runtime regression test now takes only the latest official release tag strictly before the commit under test: candidate tags, including an -rc.N tag on that very commit, are no longer mistaken for an older runtime, so the Release workflow's test step no longer fails once an rc tag exists.; agenthelm check now runs one read-only opinion-manager migrate preview (5 s timeout, zero writes) for projects that have opinion.lock.json. When content can move to on-demand tag loading it prints one advisory line (target profile, update summary, unfinished inbox records and a copyable preview command); a manual-edit or catalog conflict gets a short note; every other case stays silent. The advisory does not change the exit code or up_to_date; the session-start hook and the nudge never call migrate; check --output json gains an opinion_migrate array only when a hint is shown, existing fields unchanged. If you do not migrate, nothing changes and current behaviour is unaffected.; Add the read-only command agenthelm inventory: list the Skills and MCP servers each client can see (including ~/.agents/skills, project-level and Claude local-level stores), duplicates, description bytes and recognizable origin, as stable JSON carrying schema_version.; inventory and doctor read Claude Desktop's claude_desktop_config.json read-only as the separate target claude-desktop (must be named or use --client all; not in the default client set); doctor --client claude adds an advisory shadowed-by hint for same-name entries.; Documentation update: README, INSTALL, MIGRATION and the plugin Skills cover skills and MCP management, scope declarations, client drivers, the language=en launcher update path and 6.14.0 migration notes; the write-command inventory is completed.; agent-pack adds scope declaration: the Project Profile keys capabilities.default_scope / mcp_scope / skill_scope and --scope on sync and reconcile. Entries declared project-level are no longer written to the user level (skipped with a warning for now; project-level writes follow in later releases), the preview is grouped by scope and shows the narrowing impact; without the new keys behavior and output are unchanged.; agent-pack can write MCP servers declared project-level to Claude's project stores: local by default (under the project's path in ~/.claude.json, backed up first, permissions kept, rolled back on failure) or, with --project-store file, the project's .mcp.json (entries tied to this machine are refused). An unwritable or unrecognized target is skipped with a warning, never written to the user level instead.; agent-pack can write Skills declared project-level to the project's .claude/skills (relative symbolic links, copies inside sync folders, a same-name conflict needs --replace-skills), and previews a scope change as two steps: write the new location and retire the old one. A Skill's old location is archived in the same transaction; an MCP entry's old location only gets a manual removal command. Same-name entries in several stores get an advisory shadow notice where the official documentation states the precedence; ok and the exit code are unaffected.; Add agenthelm relocate: copy or move one Skill to another client/scope. Preview by default, confirmed with a plan digest; never overwrites an existing directory, reads back and verifies, rolls back on failure and only archives (never deletes) the source; widening the scope needs --allow-widen.; Add agenthelm dedupe: handle the duplicate groups inventory reports. Skill copies can be kept once with the rest archived (recoverable, never deleted); MCP copies get only the official manual command and no config is edited; keep-all and ignore write only a machine-level decision file; plus a read-only paste-ready Claude Desktop config snippet.; agenthelm relocate now handles MCP entries: copy or move them between Claude's user, local and project .mcp.json scopes; preview equals apply, an existing target is never overwritten, inline secrets and machine paths cannot enter .mcp.json, narrowing only (widening needs --allow-widen). A managed source entry is retired by an atomic edit of ~/.claude.json with a byte-exact backup first and rollback; an unmanaged entry is only copied, with a manual command.; agenthelm dedupe --keep --retire-others now retires managed MCP copies itself (original JSON fragment into a 0600 recovery directory, byte-exact backup of ~/.claude.json first, atomic edit, byte-exact rollback); unmanaged copies still get only the official manual command; members with unknown evidence stay read-only and cross-client same-fingerprint copies remain keep-recommended advice.

summary: 文档更新：README、INSTALL、MIGRATION 与各插件 Skill 补充技能与 MCP 管理、作用域声明、client 驱动、language=en 启动器更新办法及 6.14.0 迁移说明；write-commands 盘点补全。; agent-pack 新增作用域声明：Project Profile 的 capabilities.default_scope / mcp_scope / skill_scope 与 sync、reconcile 的 --scope。声明为 project 的条目不再写入用户级（本版跳过并警告，项目级写入随后续版本提供），预览按作用域分组并给出收窄影响；不写新键时行为与输出不变。; language=en 的项目不再生成含中文的文件：根目录启动器（含头部注释与报错/指引文案）与 private/.gitignore 随项目文件语言生成；zh 与缺省语言的输出逐字节不变。以前用 --language en 生成的项目，其启动器仍是中文，需预览后整份替换。
summary_en: Documentation update: README, INSTALL, MIGRATION and the plugin Skills cover skills and MCP management, scope declarations, client drivers, the language=en launcher update path and 6.14.0 migration notes; the write-command inventory is completed.; agent-pack adds scope declaration: the Project Profile keys capabilities.default_scope / mcp_scope / skill_scope and --scope on sync and reconcile. Entries declared project-level are no longer written to the user level (skipped with a warning for now; project-level writes follow in later releases), the preview is grouped by scope and shows the narrowing impact; without the new keys behavior and output are unchanged.; Projects with language=en no longer get files that contain Chinese: the root launcher (header comment and error/guidance messages) and private/.gitignore follow the project file language; zh and default-language output is byte-identical. Projects generated earlier with --language en keep a Chinese launcher until it is replaced after a preview.

user_action_required.what: 以前用 --language en 生成的项目：根目录启动器（默认 ./menu，名称见 Profile 的 entry.launcher）仍是中文版。先运行 `agenthelm check` 查看差异，再运行 `agenthelm fix` 预览（默认不写入），确认后用 `agenthelm fix --apply` 整份替换为英文版；你改过启动器时该文件会被阻止，需逐文件选择保留、合并或接受。language=zh 或缺省的项目不受影响；已存在的 private/.gitignore 不会被改写。

summary: 确认频率可调：inbox brief 增加 ask / digest / quiet 三种确认模式，nudge 增加 confirm 与 prompt_cooldown_hours 配置并在 stop 前先问 gate；文档补充 hook 路径的硬限制与模型自判路径的边界。; 收件箱记录展示快照，采纳预览返回 shown_matches 与 added_lines；新增询问节流 gate（只记账，状态在 .opinion/ask-state.json）。; 候选收件箱新增条件、目的、不适用与关系备注（缺失仅警告），采纳写入的规则行与 OPINION.md 框架随项目文件语言；en 项目的锁带 language，旧运行时读不了。; 公开 catalog 新增 1.1.0（31 条规则与 10 个模板）：zh/en 双语文字与 trigger / purpose / exclude，行为语义与 1.0.0 一致；两个场景模板另声明常驻集合与四个按需标签（decisions、files、reports、maintenance），选择它们时 profile 预览生成 schema 2.2 的标签加载声明，经确认后才生效，--no-tags 保持完整读取。既有项目不会自动变化，可用 updates 查看并经完整预览确认升级。; 公开规则与模板支持 {zh, en} 双语字段与可选的 trigger / purpose / exclude；profile、compose 按项目语言选取文字，en 项目选用缺译文的公开规则时预览给出 untranslated 警告（不阻断）。; 收件箱新增只读 check（报告缺条件/目的的候选与 OPINION.md 行）、revise（修订候选并留痕）和机械关系提示（relations，仅供参考）。; opinion 规则可以路由到某个 skill：inbox add / revise 新增 --route-skill、--route-when、--route-final、--route-on，渲染成 OPINION.md 自定义段里带机器可读标记的一行，并自动追加「skill 自身执行时不再触发」与「skill 不可用时降级」两条约束；新增只读 inbox routes list 列出路由并做机械检查。路由只能提高调用概率，不能保证。; 新增 opinion_manager.py migrate：把用户现有的 Opinion（Profile 2.0 / 2.1）迁移到标签选择加载。默认预览（零写入，失败路径也一样），--apply --confirm <指纹> 才写入；写入前备份到 .opinion/backups/<时间戳>-migrate/ 并写 manifest，复用 profile → compose → verify 的原子写与读回，失败按备份逐字节还原；--rollback 只在当前状态等于迁移后状态时还原。用户的 custom 段与手工追加的内容原样保留、常驻，不替用户猜标签；2.1 默认不动，--tags 才改用标签。另新增 catalog 1.1.0 的体积守卫测试。既有项目不会自动变化。; opinion-manager 的主 Skill 说明按 Profile 版本区分读取命令：2.1 声明用 context bundle，2.2 标签声明用 context select --tag；保留 fallback 时完整读取的条件。; opinion-manager 新增标签选择引擎（Profile schema 2.2）：一条规则可带多个标签，context select --tag 按标签并集读取规则，core 输出常驻规则与标签索引，check 由标签派生交付信号；自定义规则可用 [tags …] 行尾标记带标签，inbox add / revise 新增 --tag。既有 2.0 与 2.1 的 Profile 与 OPINION.md 字节不变。; opinion-manager 的 lifecycle 支持 Profile schema 2.2 的标签记账：use 事件新增 loaded_tags 与 routing_miss_tags，取值校验自 loading.tags；有标签漏读的使用与规则束漏读一样阻断转正式；status 对标签输出 loaded_in、exercised_in、routing_misses 与 unused_tags。2.1 的 loaded_bundles、routing_miss、bundles 输出不变。
summary_en: Confirmation frequency is tunable: inbox brief gains the ask / digest / quiet confirmation modes, nudge gains the confirm and prompt_cooldown_hours settings and asks the gate before stop, and the docs state the hard limits of the hook path and the boundary of the model-judged path.; The inbox records a shown snapshot, the adopt preview returns shown_matches and added_lines, and a new ask-throttling gate command keeps its bookkeeping in .opinion/ask-state.json.; The candidate inbox gains trigger, purpose, exclusion and relation fields (missing ones only warn); the rule line and OPINION.md frame written on adopt follow the project file language. The lock of an en project carries language, which older runtimes cannot read.; The public catalog gains 1.1.0 (31 rules and 10 templates): zh/en text with trigger / purpose / exclude, behaviourally identical to 1.0.0. The two scenario templates also declare a resident set and four on-demand tags (decisions, files, reports, maintenance); selecting them makes the profile preview generate a schema 2.2 tag-loading declaration that only takes effect after confirmation, and --no-tags keeps full reading. Existing projects do not change automatically; updates lists the new versions and the upgrade needs a full preview and confirmation.; Public rules and templates accept {zh, en} localized fields and optional trigger / purpose / exclude; profile and compose pick text by the project language, and an en project that selects a public rule without a translation gets an untranslated warning in the preview (not blocking).; The inbox gains a read-only check (reports candidates and OPINION.md lines missing a trigger or purpose), revise (edit a candidate with history) and mechanical relation hints (relations, for reference only).; Opinion rules can route to a skill: inbox add / revise gain --route-skill, --route-when, --route-final and --route-on, rendered as a line in the custom section of OPINION.md with a machine-readable marker plus two automatic constraints (no re-trigger while the skill runs, fallback when it is unavailable); a new read-only inbox routes list shows the routes and runs mechanical checks. A route raises the chance of the skill being called but cannot guarantee it.; Add opinion_manager.py migrate: migrate a user's existing Opinion (Profile 2.0 / 2.1) to tag-based loading. It previews by default (nothing is written, failure paths included) and writes only with --apply --confirm <fingerprint>; before writing it backs up to .opinion/backups/<timestamp>-migrate/ with a manifest, reuses the atomic profile → compose → verify write and read-back, and restores the backup byte for byte on failure; --rollback restores only while the current state still equals the migrated state. The user's custom section and hand-written additions are kept as written and always loaded; no tags are guessed for the user. 2.1 stays untouched unless --tags is given. Also adds a size-budget test for catalog 1.1.0. Existing projects do not change automatically.; The opinion-manager Skill now tells agents which read command to use per Profile version: context bundle for 2.1 declarations, context select --tag for 2.2 tag declarations; the full-read fallback conditions are unchanged.; opinion-manager gains a tag selection engine (Profile schema 2.2): a rule can carry several tags, context select --tag reads the union of the chosen tags, core prints the always-loaded rules with a tag index, and check derives delivery signals from tags; custom rules can carry tags through a trailing [tags …] marker, and inbox add / revise gain --tag. Existing 2.0 and 2.1 Profiles and OPINION.md bytes are unchanged.; opinion-manager lifecycle now records tags for Profile schema 2.2: use events gain loaded_tags and routing_miss_tags, validated against loading.tags; a use with a missed tag blocks formalization just like a missed bundle; status reports loaded_in, exercised_in, routing_misses and unused_tags per tag. The 2.1 loaded_bundles, routing_miss and bundles output are unchanged.

user_action_required.what: 可选：运行 opinion_manager.py updates 查看公开规则与模板的 1.1.0，需要时按完整预览确认升级（手工修改会保留；场景模板的标签加载声明随预览一并生成，不需要时加 --no-tags）
可选：运行 opinion_manager.py migrate --project <项目> 查看迁移预览，确认后加 --apply --confirm <指纹> 写入；不迁移则保持原样（2.1 项目要改用标签再加 --tags）；写入前自动备份，可用 --rollback 回滚

summary: 文档更新：README、INSTALL、MIGRATION 与各插件 Skill 补充技能与 MCP 管理、作用域声明、client 驱动、language=en 启动器更新办法及 6.14.0 迁移说明；write-commands 盘点补全。; 技能与 MCP 清单向 agenthelm inventory 要求全部客户端，包含只读的 Claude Desktop 条目，并在按项目看里归入「仅 Desktop 应用」。; 技能与 MCP 视图：英文措辞不再依赖数量（修正「1 groups」），缺失的 Claude Desktop 配置不再计为未知项；新增用真实 agenthelm inventory 的端到端测试。; 项目菜单新增第 9 屏「技能与 MCP」（只读）：按客户端、按项目、按重复查看与技能体检；检查屏对重复发现增加跳转；原有 1–8 号不变。; 新增 agenthelm project extensions list / dups / show / check：只读地列出技能与 MCP、重复组、条目详情与机械体检；数据来自 agenthelm inventory，能力状态里增加 extensions 一项。; 新增 agenthelm project extensions move / dedupe / scope：默认预览、--apply 才写。move 与 dedupe 转发 agenthelm relocate / dedupe 并原样展示其计划，应用时用 --expect-plan 回传同一摘要，摘要不一致即拒绝；scope 把生效范围写成 Project Profile 的 mcp_scope / skill_scope 声明（先备份、原子写入）。写入后重新读取 inventory 与计划比对。; 菜单第 9 屏的「移动或复制」「设置生效范围」成为真实向导，条目详情与重复组里新增 m / s / d / p：选条目、选目标、预览（计划、blocked、将进入项目目录的提示）、输入 yes（放宽另需键入条目名）、执行、再取 inventory 读回；读回不一致显示「读回失败」与恢复目录，菜单退出码为 1。证据未知的条目与 MCP 条目只给手工命令与可粘贴片段；没有对应 agenthelm dedupe 分组的重复只读展示。; language=en 的项目不再生成含中文的文件：根目录启动器（含头部注释与报错/指引文案）与 private/.gitignore 随项目文件语言生成；zh 与缺省语言的输出逐字节不变。以前用 --language en 生成的项目，其启动器仍是中文，需预览后整份替换。
summary_en: Documentation update: README, INSTALL, MIGRATION and the plugin Skills cover skills and MCP management, scope declarations, client drivers, the language=en launcher update path and 6.14.0 migration notes; the write-command inventory is completed.; The Skills & MCP views ask agenthelm inventory for all clients, including the read-only Claude Desktop entries, and group them under Desktop app only in the by-project view.; Skills & MCP views: English wording no longer depends on a count (fixes "1 groups"), a missing Claude Desktop config is no longer counted as an unknown item; adds an end-to-end test against the real agenthelm inventory.; The project menu gains screen 9, Skills & MCP (read-only): view by client, by project and by duplicate, plus a skill check; the health screen links duplicate findings to it.
